_note: EXAMPLE DATA. A fictional business used to demonstrate the dashboard. None of these numbers are real.

decisions.supporting_data: Sold out three months running at 1800, 4.8 satisfaction
decisions.expected_outcome: Same volume, a third more revenue per client
decisions.result: Volume held at five a month, revenue per client up 33 percent

decisions.decision: Keep Google search ads running through winter
decisions.supporting_data: Cheapest cost per lead in April
decisions.expected_outcome: Steady low-cost leads through the quiet months
decisions.result: Cost per lead has tripled since April and one client came from it

decisions.decision: Move membership onboarding to a live welcome call
decisions.supporting_data: Churn concentrated in the first 60 days

decisions.decision: Book the retreat venue for twelve rather than six
decisions.supporting_data: Waitlist of nine for the last one
decisions.expected_outcome: Twelve seats sold, better cost per head
decisions.result: Six sold. Fixed cost is now carried by half the seats

decisions.decision: Hand the daily image posts to the scheduler agent
decisions.supporting_data: Four hours a week spent on manual scheduling
decisions.expected_outcome: Four hours back, no drop in engagement
